sentences.en: She was diagnosed with leukaemia last year.
sentences.zh: 她去年被诊断出患有白血病。

sentences.en: The doctor recommended a bone marrow transplant for her leukaemia.
sentences.zh: 医生建议她做骨髓移植来治疗白血病。

sentences.en: Many people don't realize that leukaemia can affect anyone, regardless of age.
sentences.zh: 很多人不知道白血病可以影响任何人，不分年龄。
